history.text: Obudu's headquarters lies in the Bette clan, with the Bette-Bendi in the centre and the Ukpe-Alege in the south. The Obudu area holds six clans, Bette, Obanliku, Bendi, Utuwang, Ukpe-Alege and Utanga-Becheve, each of independent villages bound by kinship; their origin is unknown, but they probably came from the east and were settled here by the 18th century.

summary.text: The Bette are the main people of Obudu LGA in northern Cross River State. Utugwang, Ubang and Alege communities also live there.
